label: PvuRts1I system
definition: A type IV modification-dependent restriction system in which an organism possesses a PvuRts1I-family locus encoding a restriction endonuclease that recognizes 5-hydroxymethylcytosine or 5-glucosylhydroxymethylcytosine in double-stranded DNA and cleaves both strands on the 3'-side away from the recognized modified cytosine.
observations: PvuRts1I branch under type IV modification-dependent restriction system; distinct from individual PvuRts1I-family proteins, individual PvuRts1I-family genes, PvuRts1I-family nuclease activity outside a complete organism-level Type IV anti-phage system, individual 5-hydroxymethylcytosine or 5-glucosylhydroxymethylcytosine DNA substrate classes, and the DefenseFinder PvuRts1I source key outside a complete organism-level system.
